name: Tres Marias ~3 Nin no Sei Shojo~
original_name: トレス・マリアス～3人の聖処女～
source:
A church on an isolated island. Main character receives a letter from this church asking for help to learn why the state of sisters became strange. Sisters turn out to be sexually aroused which is absolutely strange since sex is absolutely forbidden to them by doctrine. Hero investigates sexuality of the girls and decides to accompany it with sex education.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一座孤岛上的教堂。主人公收到了这封来自教堂的求助信，请求帮助调查修女们的状态为何变得异常。结果修女们出现了性兴奋的症状——这绝对很奇怪，因为教义是绝对禁止她们进行性行为的。主人公调查了女孩们的性状况，并决定辅以性教育。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
